description: This is a React component source file defining the LandingPage and associated subcomponents for the Applicant Portal frontend of a business loan application platform.

methods.name: LandingPage
methods.description: Main functional component rendering the landing page layout with navigation, hero section, features, trust strip, FAQ, and footer.

methods.name: Navbar
methods.description: Renders the sticky header navigation bar with links to page sections and authentication actions.

methods.name: Hero
methods.description: Displays the hero section with a headline, description, call-to-action buttons, and visual illustration.

methods.name: Features
methods.description: Showcases the platform's key features using icon cards.

methods.name: TrustStrip
methods.description: Displays trust indicators, funding metrics, and partner logos.

methods.name: Faq
methods.description: Provides a list of frequently asked questions with answers.

methods.name: Footer
methods.description: Renders the page footer with links, legal info, and API documentation link.
